title: Brand, writing and design-system audit work package
scope: Original brand/writing review and whole-system audit, followed by authorised remediation: 16 confirmed findings, 4 recommendations, 14 ownership decisions, 30 dedicated Home Assistant specifications and 104 additional examples. Native live-task coverage remains separately bounded. The 12 November completeness supplement adds 632 registry mappings, 456 terminology entries, 681 contextual native labels, eight additional task families and 45 examples; source coverage and native implementation remain separate.
completion_meaning: A completed review means its documented scope has been covered. Open audit findings remain open until their acceptance evidence exists.

Native Home Assistant and third-party behaviour require their own release-specific live checks.
Reference examples use invented household data and do not control devices.
